semantic_gold.construction: Frozen from category definitions and public product terminology by an isolated agent that did not inspect evaluated outputs.

cohort.selection: Exactly the frozen matched Table 2 cohort; no post-outcome reselection.

part_unit: One URDF link with at least one valid renderable visual geometry, identical to the matched direct Naming evaluator.

inputs: target-highlighted context and isolated geometry previews
judge_design.consensus: At least two judges must give the same non-uncertain name verdict. Required semantic fields use at least two identical votes among judges supporting that verdict.
judge_design.readiness: Headline metrics are emitted only when every task has a name-verdict consensus and every metric-specific annotation has consensus.

annotation_fields.judge_verdict: Whether the link name truthfully identifies a required role, another real part, is opaque/incorrect, or cannot be decided.
annotation_fields.judge_matched_role: Required role ID for spec_match; null otherwise.
annotation_fields.judge_geometry_role: Role visible in geometry independent of naming: a frozen role ID, other_real_part:<short_label>, or unknown.
annotation_fields.judge_geometry_is_real_part: Whether highlighted geometry is a coherent physical/functional part rather than a stray fragment or artifact.
annotation_fields.judge_instance_id: For repeated geometry-role instances, identity actually conveyed by the name; ambiguous when not distinguished, not_applicable for singleton roles.
annotation_fields.judge_same_semantic_part_as: none or another node name in the same asset when both links are fragments of the same semantic part.

formulas.semantic_precision_micro: consensus truthfully named nodes / all consensus-judged renderable nodes
formulas.semantic_recall_asset_macro: mean over assets of min(1, consensus spec-match count for each required role) / required role count
formulas.semantic_recall_micro: sum covered required roles / sum required roles
formulas.judge_validated_naming_richness_asset_ma: mean over assets of consensus truthfully named nodes / required role count
formulas.judge_validated_naming_richness_micro: sum consensus truthfully named nodes / sum required roles
formulas.functional_core_coverage_asset_macro: mean over assets of covered required functional roles / required functional role count
formulas.functional_core_coverage_micro: sum covered required functional roles / sum required functional roles
formulas.instance_discriminability_micro: over geometry-role groups with at least two consensus real-part nodes, sum nodes with a distinct non-ambiguous name-conveyed instance ID / sum nodes
formulas.over_segmentation_rate_micro: consensus same-semantic-part excess fragments / consensus geometry-real renderable nodes
formulas.over_segmentation_rate_asset_macro: mean per-asset excess fragments / geometry-real renderable nodes

aggregation.primary: micro for precision, instance discriminability, and over-segmentation; asset macro for recall, richness, and functional coverage
aggregation.also_report: Both micro and asset-macro variants wherever defined, raw counts, applicability denominators, and judge agreement.
aggregation.zero_applicability: Instance discriminability is reported as null, not one, when a method has no repeated geometry-role group.

bootstrap.unit: canonical category cluster; resample five categories with replacement and retain all method assets within sampled categories

interpretation_limits: Judges are LLM agents, not human annotators; report this explicitly.
Point-cloud previews show zero-pose geometry and do not establish articulation correctness.
Semantic recall uses minimal category roles and does not penalize absent optional components.
A role fused into another link may be covered only when the link name truthfully identifies the required role or an inclusive category term under the frozen gold.
Cross-seed consistency is a separate direct-output metric and is not inferred from semantic judgments.
